# cloudcn

> Copy-paste WebGL cloud components for React and Tailwind, in the style of shadcn/ui. Seven raymarched or layered shader clouds on transparent backgrounds, so they float over any UI. MIT licensed, TypeScript, no package install: you copy the code and own it.

cloudcn is a component library you vendor into your own repo, not an npm dependency. Each cloud is a real shader on a transparent canvas: 3D fBm density raymarched in a fragment shader with Beer-Lambert absorption, powder darkening and Henyey-Greenstein silver linings, or layered 2D noise for the thin clouds. Every canvas pauses off screen, respects prefers-reduced-motion, and shows a static SVG cloud if WebGL is unavailable or fails.

## Components

- [Nimbus](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/nimbus.tsx): one fair-weather volumetric cumulus, drag to orbit
- [Dusk](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/dusk.tsx): the same volume lit by a low sun, warm edges and violet shadows
- [Tempest](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/tempest.tsx): storm tower with an anvil top, `lightning` 0 to 1
- [Horizon](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/horizon.tsx): wide cloud bank for a hero base or divider
- [Wisp](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/wisp.tsx): thin high streaks, `tone` white or slate, sits behind text
- [Haze](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/haze.tsx): low fog that thickens toward the bottom edge
- [Stratus](https://github.com/Unselfisheologism/cloudcn/blob/main/src/components/ui/stratus.tsx): a full cloud sky, kept as an extra

## Install

Copy `src/lib/utils.ts`, `src/lib/glcanvas.tsx` and `src/lib/fallback.tsx` (plus `src/lib/volume.tsx` for Nimbus, Dusk, Tempest and Horizon), then copy the component file from `src/components/ui/`. Tailwind v4 with the `@` alias pointing at `src` is assumed.

A shadcn-style registry with inline file contents is served from this site, so the CLI flow also works: `npx shadcn@latest add "https://cloudcn.pages.dev/r/nimbus.json"`.

## Shared props

`coverage` (0 to 1), `density`, `speed` (0 freezes motion), `sunElevation`, `sunAzimuth`, `quality` (render scale 0.25 to 1), `steps`, `seed`, `time` (fixed time for stills), `interactive`.

## Honest limits

Procedural clouds, not photographs. Tempest is soft. Dusk shows a faint green fringe on very dark backgrounds. Tested in headless Chrome with software rendering; real phone GPU speed is not measured.
